fire:
These new and unusual pesticides were found in
the river by the local survey team.

Please note that all of the attached forms
must be signed before the end of the month.

The old station was closed for repairs and
reopened to passengers two years later.

You may copy this file in any form or as a
printed document, for any purpose at all.

Many of the early photographs taken by
the crew were later shown in a museum.

We tested these two methods using
small samples of soil and clean water.

Remember that the first draft of a
report is rarely the one you should send.

It was all done with floppy disks using
a simple tool that came with the system.
